<script>
  function onLoad() {
    // If we don't have skills added yet, we need to add the default skill groups and skills
    const skillGroups1 = record?.data?.skillGroups1 || [];
    const skillGroups2 = record?.data?.skillGroups2 || [];
    if (skillGroups1.length === 0 && skillGroups2.length === 0) {
      const allSkills = getAllSkills();

      // Helper function to add skill groups recursively one at a time
      function addSkillGroupSequentially(skillGroups, index) {
        // Base case: all skill groups processed
        if (index >= skillGroups.length) {
          return;
        }

        const skillGroup = skillGroups[index];
        const groupField = skillGroup.groupField;

        // Add the skill group to the character
        api.addValue(
          `data.${groupField}`,
          {
            name: skillGroup.groupName,
          },
          (record) => {
            const skillGroupIndex = record.data[groupField].length - 1;
            // Add skills to the skill group
            // Map skills to expected format
            const skills = skillGroup.skills.map((skill) => {
              let statToCheck = skill.stat;
              if (statToCheck === "emp") {
                statToCheck = "curEmp";
              } else if (statToCheck === "luck") {
                statToCheck = "curLuck";
              }
              const statValue = record.data?.[statToCheck] || 0;
              return {
                name: skill.name,
                data: {
                  stat: skill.stat,
                  isDefault: skill.isDefault,
                  isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
                  hasSubskills: skill.hasSubskills,
                  lvl: !skill.hasSubskills
                    ? skill.isDefault
                      ? 2
                      : 0
                    : undefined,
                  base: !skill.hasSubskills
                    ? skill.isDefault
                      ? 2 + statValue
                      : statValue
                    : undefined,
                  subSkills: skill.hasSubskills
                    ? skill.subSkills.map((subSkill) => {
                        return {
                          _id: generateUuid(),
                          name: subSkill.name,
                          undefinedName: subSkill.name,
                          data: {
                            stat: skill.stat,
                            isDefault: subSkill.isDefault,
                            isTimesTwo: skill.isTimesTwo,
                            lvl: subSkill.isDefault ? 2 : 0,
                            base: subSkill.isDefault
                              ? 2 + statValue
                              : statValue,
                            hasSubskills: false,
                          },
                          fields: {
                            name: {
                              hidden: !subSkill.isDefault,
                            },
                            namefield: {
                              hidden: subSkill.isDefault,
                            },
                          },
                        };
                      })
                    : [],
                },
                recordType: "skill",
                // Hide/unhide the name and namefield fields based on isDefault
                fields: {
                  name: {
                    hidden: !skill.isDefault,
                  },
                  stat: {
                    hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                  },
                  base: {
                    hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                  },
                  lvl: {
                    hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                  },
                  rollSkill: {
                    hidden: skill.hasSubskills,
                  },
                  namefield: {
                    hidden: skill.isDefault,
                  },
                  subSkills: {
                    hidden: !skill.hasSubskills,
                  },
                },
              };
            });
            api.addValues(
              `data.${groupField}.${skillGroupIndex}.data.skills`,
              skills,
              (record) => {
                // Move to the next skill group only after the current one is complete
                addSkillGroupSequentially(skillGroups, index + 1);
              }
            );
          }
        );
      }

      // Start the sequential process with the first skill group
      addSkillGroupSequentially(allSkills, 0);
    }
  }

  function onDrop(type, recordLink) {
    if (type === "roles") {
      onDropRole(recordLink);
    } else if (type === "conditions") {
      onDropCondition(recordLink);
    }
  }

  function onDropRole(recordLink) {
    addRole(record, recordLink);
  }

  function onRoleDelete() {
    updateRoles(record);
  }

  function onDropCondition(recordLink) {
    addCondition(record, recordLink);
  }

  function onUpdateStat(value, stat) {
    const bestEquippedArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
    const penalty = bestEquippedArmor.highestPenalty;
    setStatsAndSkills(record, value, stat, null, penalty, true);
  }

  function onConditionChange() {
    const deletedItem = data.deletedItem;
    if (!deletedItem) return;

    const deletedEffects = deletedItem.data?.effects || [];
    const recordId = record._id;

    // Update attributes based on modifiers
    // First update attributes based on modifiers
    const valuesToSet = {};
    const bestEquippedArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
    // Update attributes as per modifiers
    updateAttributes(valuesToSet, bestEquippedArmor.highestPenalty);
    valuesToSet["data.headArmor"] = bestEquippedArmor.head[0]?.name || "";
    valuesToSet["data.headArmorSP"] = bestEquippedArmor.head[0]?.curSp || 0;
    valuesToSet["data.headArmorPenalty"] =
      bestEquippedArmor.head[0]?.penalty || 0;
    valuesToSet["data.bodyArmor"] = bestEquippedArmor.body[0]?.name || "";
    valuesToSet["data.bodyArmorSP"] = bestEquippedArmor.body[0]?.curSp || 0;
    valuesToSet["data.bodyArmorPenalty"] =
      bestEquippedArmor.body[0]?.penalty || 0;
    valuesToSet["data.shield"] = bestEquippedArmor.shield[0]?.name || "";
    valuesToSet["data.shieldHP"] = bestEquippedArmor.shield[0]?.curSp || 0;
    valuesToSet["data.shieldPenalty"] =
      bestEquippedArmor.shield[0]?.penalty || 0;

    if (Object.keys(valuesToSet).length > 0) {
      api.setValues(valuesToSet);
    }

    // Process effects sequentially using a recursive approach
    function processEffectsSequentially(effects, index) {
      // Base case: all effects processed
      if (index >= effects.length) return;

      // Re-query the record to get the latest data
      api.getRecord("characters", recordId, (recordUpdated) => {
        // Process current effect
        const effect = effects[index];
        const effectObj = JSON.parse(effect);

        // Remove the effect and wait for completion before processing the next one
        api.removeEffectById(effectObj._id, recordUpdated, () => {
          // Process next effect (only after current removal is complete)
          processEffectsSequentially(effects, index + 1);
        });
      });
    }

    // Start processing from the first effect
    if (deletedEffects.length > 0) {
      processEffectsSequentially(deletedEffects, 0);
    }
  }

  function useLuck() {
    // Close the popover to trigger the onUseLuck function.
    api.closeOpenedPopovers();
  }

  function onUseLuck() {
    // First re-query the record, in case we're in the middle of updating
    // on blur of the useLuck field.
    const recordId = record._id;
    // First, wait for the useLuck field to be updated, then re-query the record.
    setTimeout(() => {
      api.getRecord("characters", recordId, (record) => {
        const useLuck = record.data?.useLuck || 0;

        const valuesToSet = {
          "data.useLuck": 0,
        };

        if (useLuck > 0) {
          // Deduct the amount from curLuck, and add store the amount deducted
          // so we can add it as a bonus to the next roll
          const curLuck = record.data?.curLuck || 0;
          const amountDeducted = Math.min(useLuck, curLuck);
          valuesToSet["data.curLuck"] = curLuck - amountDeducted;
          valuesToSet["data.nextRoll"] =
            (record.data?.nextRoll || 0) + amountDeducted;

          const tags = [
            {
              tooltip: "Used luck.",
              name: "Luck",
            },
          ];

          api.setValues(valuesToSet);

          if (amountDeducted > 0) {
            api.sendMessage(
              `${amountDeducted} Luck used. Next roll will be at +${valuesToSet["data.nextRoll"]}`,
              undefined,
              [],
              tags
            );
          }
        }
      });
    }, 500);
  }

  function onRest() {
    // Get modifiers for healing
    const healingModifiers = getEffectsAndModifiersForToken(
      record,
      "healingBonus"
    );
    const healingBonus = healingModifiers.reduce(
      (acc, mod) => acc + mod.value,
      0
    );

    //  Recover up to BODY hp + any modifiers for healing
    // Use actualBody where we track the actual value used for HP
    const body = record.data?.actualBody || 0;
    const healingAmount = body + healingBonus;
    const curhp = record.data?.curhp || 0;
    const hitpoints = record.data?.hitpoints || 0;
    const newHp = Math.min(curhp + healingAmount, hitpoints);

    const valuesToSet = {
      "data.curhp": newHp,
      "data.deathSave": body,
    };

    // Go through each effect, look up the item with that ID in inventory, and heal it by the value of the effect
    const inventory = record.data?.inventory || [];
    let healedArmor = [];
    const bestArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
    inventory.forEach((item, itemIndex) => {
      // Check for healCurrentSp effects for this item
      const healCurrentSpEffects = getEffectsAndModifiersForToken(
        record,
        ["healCurrentSp"],
        "",
        item._id
      );
      if (healCurrentSpEffects.length > 0) {
        healCurrentSpEffects.forEach((effect) => {
          if (effect.itemId === item._id) {
            let maxSp = item.data?.armorSp || 0;
            let maxHeadSp = maxSp;
            let maxBodySp = maxSp;
            let maxShieldSp = maxSp;
            // Some items define SP in a modifier, so check that here too
            const modifiers = item.data?.modifiers || [];
            modifiers.forEach((modifier) => {
              if (
                modifier.data?.type === "headSp" ||
                modifier.data?.type === "bodySp" ||
                modifier.data?.type === "shieldSp"
              ) {
                const modValue = parseInt(modifier.data?.value, 10);
                if (modValue > maxSp) {
                  if (modifier.data?.type === "headSp") {
                    maxHeadSp = modValue;
                  } else if (modifier.data?.type === "bodySp") {
                    maxBodySp = modValue;
                  } else if (modifier.data?.type === "shieldSp") {
                    maxShieldSp = modValue;
                  }
                }
              }
            });
            let curHeadSp = parseInt(item.data?.curheadSp, 10);
            let curBodySp = parseInt(item.data?.curbodySp, 10);
            let curShieldSp = parseInt(item.data?.curshieldSp, 10);
            if (isNaN(curHeadSp)) {
              curHeadSp = Math.max(maxHeadSp, maxSp);
            }
            if (isNaN(curBodySp)) {
              curBodySp = Math.max(maxBodySp, maxSp);
            }
            if (isNaN(curShieldSp)) {
              curShieldSp = Math.max(maxShieldSp, maxSp);
            }

            const spHealAmount = effect.value;
            const newHeadSp = Math.min(maxHeadSp, curHeadSp + spHealAmount);
            const newBodySp = Math.min(maxBodySp, curBodySp + spHealAmount);
            const newShieldSp = Math.min(
              maxShieldSp,
              curShieldSp + spHealAmount
            );

            // If this is cyberware, set all SP to the same value else just set the ones that are different
            if (item.data?.type === "cyberware") {
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curheadSp`] =
                newHeadSp;
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curbodySp`] =
                newBodySp;
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curshieldSp`] =
                newShieldSp;
            } else if (item.data?.armorLocation === "head") {
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curheadSp`] =
                newHeadSp;
            } else if (item.data?.armorLocation === "body") {
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curbodySp`] =
                newBodySp;
            } else if (item.data?.armorLocation === "shield") {
              valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${itemIndex}.data.curshieldSp`] =
                newShieldSp;
            }

            if (newHeadSp - curHeadSp > 0) {
              healedArmor.push({
                name: item.name,
                amount: newHeadSp - curHeadSp,
              });
            }
            // If this is the same armor as what we're showing on the character, update the attributes
            if (item._id === bestArmor.head?.[0]?._id) {
              valuesToSet["data.headArmorSP"] = newHeadSp;
            }
            if (item._id === bestArmor.body?.[0]?._id) {
              valuesToSet["data.bodyArmorSP"] = newBodySp;
            }
            if (item._id === bestArmor.shield?.[0]?._id) {
              valuesToSet["data.shieldSP"] = newShieldSp;
            }
          }
        });
      }
    });

    api.setValues(valuesToSet, (record) => {
      // Remove any effects for Mortally Wounded or Death Save Penalties
      const effects = record?.effects || [];
      const deathSavePenaltyEffect = effects.find(
        (effect) => effect.name === "Death Save Penalty"
      );
      const mortallyWoundedEffect = effects.find(
        (effect) => effect.name === "Mortally Wounded"
      );

      if (deathSavePenaltyEffect || mortallyWoundedEffect) {
        const tokenForRecord = api.getToken() || record;

        // Function to remove Mortally Wounded effect
        const removeMortallyWounded = (currentRecord) => {
          const currentMortallyWoundedEffect = currentRecord?.effects?.find(
            (effect) => effect.name === "Mortally Wounded"
          );

          if (currentMortallyWoundedEffect) {
            const tokenForRecord = api.getToken() || currentRecord;

            api.removeEffectById(
              currentMortallyWoundedEffect._id,
              tokenForRecord
            );
          }
        };

        // First remove Death Save Penalty if it exists, then remove Mortally Wounded
        if (deathSavePenaltyEffect) {
          api.removeEffectById(
            deathSavePenaltyEffect._id,
            tokenForRecord,
            (updatedRecord) => {
              removeMortallyWounded(updatedRecord);
            }
          );
        } else {
          // Only remove Mortally Wounded
          removeMortallyWounded(tokenForRecord);
        }
      }
    });

    let message = "Resting for the day.";
    if (healingAmount > 0) {
      message += ` Recovered ${healingAmount} HP.`;
    }
    if (healingBonus > 0) {
      message += ` Healing bonus: ${healingBonus}.`;
    }

    if (healedArmor.length > 0) {
      message += ` Healed ${healedArmor
        .map((armor) => `${armor.name} by ${armor.amount}`)
        .join(". ")}.`;
    }

    api.sendMessage(message, undefined, [], []);
  }

  function onResetLuck() {
    api.setValues({
      "data.useLuck": 0,
      "data.curLuck": record.data?.luck || 0,
      "data.nextRoll": 0,
    });
  }

  function onRollDeathSave() {
    // Death save is just a d10 rolling under the body stat
    // Use actualBody where we track the actual value used for HP and Death Saves
    const body = record.data?.actualBody || 0;
    const deathSaveMetadata = {
      dv: body,
    };
    api.promptRoll("Death Save", "1d10", [], deathSaveMetadata, "deathSave");
  }

  function onUpdateSp(field) {
    const newSp = value;
    // Update the SP on the item that represents the armor
    const equippedArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
    const armor = equippedArmor[field]?.[0];
    let valuesToSet = {};
    if (armor) {
      // Find the index directly by searching through the inventory array
      const inventoryArray = record?.data?.inventory || [];
      const armorItemIndex = inventoryArray.findIndex(
        (item) => item._id === armor._id
      );

      if (armorItemIndex !== -1) {
        valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${armorItemIndex}.data.cur${field}Sp`] =
          newSp;
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(valuesToSet).length > 0) {
      api.setValues(valuesToSet);
    }
  }

  function onUpdatePenalty(field) {
    // Update the penalty on the item that represents the armor and re-update attributes
    const newPenalty = value;
    // Update the SP on the item that represents the armor
    const equippedArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
    const armor = equippedArmor[field]?.[0];
    let valuesToSet = {};
    if (armor) {
      // Find the index directly by searching through the inventory array
      const inventoryArray = record?.data?.inventory || [];
      const armorItemIndex = inventoryArray.findIndex(
        (item) => item._id === armor._id
      );
      if (armorItemIndex !== -1) {
        valuesToSet[`data.inventory.${armorItemIndex}.data.penalty`] =
          newPenalty;
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(valuesToSet).length > 0) {
      api.setValues(valuesToSet, (record) => {
        const bestEquippedArmor = getBestEquippedArmor(record);
        // Update attributes as per modifiers
        updateAttributes(valuesToSet, bestEquippedArmor.highestPenalty);
        api.setValues(valuesToSet);
      });
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
  function showHideValues(typeStr) {
    const nearestParentDataPath = getNearestParentDataPath(dataPath);
    const item = api.getValue(nearestParentDataPath) || record;

    // If this is an nested item, just return. (Like a weapon attachment)
    let pathToFields = "fields";
    if (nearestParentDataPath !== "") {
      pathToFields = `${nearestParentDataPath}.fields`;
    }
    let pathToData = "data";
    if (nearestParentDataPath !== "") {
      pathToData = `${nearestParentDataPath}.data`;
    }

    const valuesToSet = {
      [`${pathToFields}.weaponProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.dvProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.packProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.rangedWeaponProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.weaponType.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.ammoType.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.magazine.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.weaponAttachmentProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.attachmentsProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.maxSlots.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.ammoProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.armorProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.blackICEProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.demonProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.droneProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.programProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.vehicleProperties.hidden`]: true,

      [`${pathToFields}.weaponAttachedLabel.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.weaponAttached.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.cyberwareWeaponLabel.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.vehicleUpgradeProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.drugProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.consumableProperties.hidden`]:
        item?.data?.consumable || item?.data?.hasUseBtn ? false : true,
      // The below fields are only displayed on the attack list
      [`${pathToFields}.generalWeaponProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.cyberwareWeaponProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.attackDividerBox.hidden`]: false,
      [`${pathToFields}.autoFireBtn.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.suppressiveFireBtn.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.attackByRangeBtn.hidden`]: true,

      [`${pathToFields}.ammo.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.useSpecialBtn.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.ammoCount.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.curheadSp.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.curbodySp.hidden`]: true,
      [`${pathToFields}.curshieldSp.hidden`]: true,
    };

    if (typeStr === "agent app") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "ammo") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.ammoProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumableProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "armor") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.armorProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.curheadSp.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.curbodySp.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.curshieldSp.hidden`] = true;
    } else if (typeStr === "black ice") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.blackICEProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "cyberdeck") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.cyberdeckProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.maxSlots.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "cyberware") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.cyberwareProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.cyberwareWeaponLabel.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.weaponAttached.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.cyberwareWeaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.attackDividerBox.hidden`] = true;
    } else if (typeStr === "demon") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.demonProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "drone") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.droneProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "drug") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.drugProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumableProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "fashion") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
    } else if (typeStr === "gear") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "melee weapon") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.weaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.weaponType.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.attachmentsProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.maxSlots.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.generalWeaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      // Defaults for melee weapons
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.weaponSkill`] = "brawling";
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.rof`] = "1";
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.handsRequired`] = "1";
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.quality`] = "average";
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.exotic`] = "false";
      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.concealable`] = "false";
    } else if (typeStr === "program or hardware") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.programProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "ranged weapon") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.weaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.rangedWeaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.ammoType.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.magazine.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.dvProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.attachmentsProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.maxSlots.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.generalWeaponProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.attackByRangeBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.reloadBtn.hidden`] = false;

      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.ammoCount.hidden`] = false;

      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.handsRequired`] = "1";

      valuesToSet[`${pathToData}.exotic`] = "false";

      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.packProperties.hidden`] = false;

      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.vehicleProperties.hidden`] = false;

      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.vehicleUpgradeProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (typeStr === "weapon attachment") {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.weaponAttachmentProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.slots.hidden`] = false;
    } else {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumable.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.hasUseBtn.hidden`] = true;
    }

    api.setValues(valuesToSet);
  }

  function showHideAttachments() {
    // The attack list will hide this field there, if there are none.
    // But we need to show it here for editing, always
    const dataPathToWeapon = dataPath.replace(/[.]?data.attachments/, "");
    const weapon = api.getValue(dataPathToWeapon);

    const isWeapon =
      weapon?.data?.type === "ranged weapon" ||
      weapon?.data?.type === "melee weapon";

    const showingAttachments = weapon?.fields?.attachments?.hidden !== true;

    const dot = dataPathToWeapon !== "" ? "." : "";

    if (isWeapon && !showingAttachments) {
      api.setValues({
        [`${dataPathToWeapon}${dot}fields.attachments.hidden`]: false,
      });
    }
  }

  function isAttachment(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "weapon attachment";
  }

  function isWeapon(value) {
    return (
      value.data?.type === "ranged weapon" ||
      value.data?.type === "melee weapon"
    );
  }

  function isBlackICE(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "black ice";
  }

  function isProgram(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "program";
  }

  function isDemon(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "demon";
  }

  function isDrone(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "drone";
  }

  function isVehicle(value) {
    return value.data?.type === "vehicle";
  }

  function isProgramOrHardware(value) {
    return (
      value.data?.type === "program" ||
      value.data?.type === "program or hardware"
    );
  }

    // Sett the humanity loss button to unhidden
    const cyberwareDataPath = dataPath.replace(/data.humanityLoss[.]?/, "");
    api.setValues({
      [`${cyberwareDataPath}fields.humanityLossBtn.hidden`]:
        value === "" || value === undefined,
    });
  }

  function onAttachmentTypeChange(value) {
    // Rebuild the attachment data path incase this is a nested item
    let attachmentDataPath = dataPath.replace(/data.attachmentType[.]?/, "");
    const valuesToSet = {
      [`${attachmentDataPath}fields.dvProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${attachmentDataPath}fields.afDvProperties.hidden`]: true,
      [`${attachmentDataPath}fields.magazineSize.hidden`]: true,
      [`${attachmentDataPath}fields.weaponAttached.hidden`]: true,
      [`${attachmentDataPath}fields.weaponAttachedLabel.hidden`]: true,
    };

    if (value === "altRange") {
      valuesToSet[`${attachmentDataPath}fields.dvProperties.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${attachmentDataPath}fields.afDvProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (value === "magazine") {
      valuesToSet[`${attachmentDataPath}fields.magazineSize.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (value === "weapon") {
      valuesToSet[`${attachmentDataPath}fields.weaponAttached.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[
        `${attachmentDataPath}fields.weaponAttachedLabel.hidden`
      ] = false;
    }

    api.setValues(valuesToSet);
  }

    let programDataPath = dataPath.replace(/data.programHardwareType[.]?/, "");
    const valuesToSet = {
      [`${programDataPath}fields.program.hidden`]: true,
      [`${programDataPath}fields.programLabel.hidden`]: true,
    };

    if (value === "hardware" || value === "quickhack") {
      valuesToSet[`${programDataPath}fields.program.hidden`] = true;
      valuesToSet[`${programDataPath}fields.programLabel.hidden`] = true;
    } else {
      valuesToSet[`${programDataPath}fields.program.hidden`] = false;
      valuesToSet[`${programDataPath}fields.programLabel.hidden`] = false;
    }

    api.setValues(valuesToSet);

    const nearestParentDataPath = getNearestParentDataPath(dataPath);

    // If this is an nested item, just return. (Like a weapon attachment)
    let pathToFields = "fields";
    if (nearestParentDataPath !== "") {
      pathToFields = `${nearestParentDataPath}.fields`;
    }

    const valuesToSet = {};

    if (value) {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumableProperties.hidden`] = false;
    } else if (!record.data?.consumable) {
      valuesToSet[`${pathToFields}.consumableProperties.hidden`] = true;

    const nearestParentDataPath = getNearestParentDataPath(dataPath);

    // If this is an nested item, just return. (Like a weapon attachment)

        width="100%"
        field="penalty"
        label="Penalty"
        placeholder="Enter Penalty..."

        width="100%"
        field="checkDV"

      <dropdown
        width="100%"
        field="checkSkill"
        label="Skill"
        placeholder="Select Skill..."
        optionsquery='{"type": "skill", "query": {}}'

        width="100%"
        field="primaryHumanityLoss"

        field="secondaryDiceRoll"

        width="100%"
        field="secondaryHumanityLoss"

      <numberfield
        width="100%"
        field="armorSp"
        label="Armor SP"
        placeholder="Enter Armor SP..."
        minvalue="0"
      ></numberfield>
      <numberfield
        width="100%"
        field="coverHp"
        label="Cover HP"
        placeholder="Enter Cover HP..."
        minvalue="0"
      ></numberfield>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: row; width: 100%; gap: 8px">
      <numberfield
        width="100%"
        field="extraSeats"
        label="Extra Seats"
        placeholder="Enter Extra Seats..."
        minvalue="0"
      ></numberfield>
      <numberfield
        width="100%"
        field="additionalSdp"
        label="Additional SDP"
        placeholder="Enter Additional SDP..."
        minvalue="0"
      ></numberfield>
